Rule 0 (binding): read all md first; persist everything to md on disk (repo md = eternal memory); no vibe coding, every deletion/merge carries written evidence; no foolish deletions: KEEP/MERGE/DELETE verdict per file before removal.

R0.7: past work is declared '100% gold', locked, no re-litigating done work; proceed forward only. Tension with the later erratum/corrigendum culture (DEEPER corrigendum on LIVE_LATEST sat/mni claim).

Locked 3-agent architecture: Engine (OCR engines, probes, scoring, GPU, downloads only with explicit boss approval), Verdict (GT verification, forensics, scorer rules, hostile audits, leaderboards; must counter the boss with evidence), Miss (hygiene, doc merges, BOSS_CONCERNS, DISPATCH_LOG). No 4th top-level agent.

File-based append-only interfaces: level2/probe22/engine_health_log.jsonl (Engine), level2/probe22/fix_specs/ (anyone proposes, Miss applies, Verdict verifies), DISPATCH_LOG.md, BOSS_CONCERNS.md (read every turn), PROTOCOL_UPGRADES.md. Cross-check law: no output counts as truth until checked by another agent.

T1 cleanup marathon: 24-hour authorized, 10-15 sub-agents + 4-5 monitors, cycle-graph dispatch->report->verify->implement->re-audit; scope 10,000-50,000+ files; per-file WHAT/WHY/WHERE/WHO/worth answers; output AUDIT_REPORT.md.
Flag classes for hygiene: duplicates, variant copies, trash, misleading names, ordering violations, orphans. Monitors re-open random sample of verdicts and link-check every MERGE/DELETE.

T2: resolve 'old' folder at level 2 (no side-by-side stale copies); merge South-language outputs into main flow, same hierarchy/standard; ingest then DELETE external /Users/srujansai/Desktop/South/Untitled; one authoritative md per topic; FINAL_REPO_MAP.md after linkage verification.

T4 sample coverage fix: required 100 samples per language x ALL 18 languages = 1,800 minimum packs; current ~1,200-1,300 declared BELOW standard (boss-flagged deficiency). Applies to South languages too.

Sampling forbidden shortcuts: only first page of a paper, one paper per file, clustered/unrepresentative patterns. Must document per-language source-document distribution and page-offset distribution; output SAMPLING_PLAN.md; never fabricate, source only from existing PDFs.

Sampling basis is 18 languages while the directive elsewhere says all 22 scheduled languages (S4) and mentions '4 South languages' merged separately: language-count basis inconsistent inside the same document.
